messages:
incident-bot: paging maya — elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed across lb-edge clusters in eu-west and us-central. Rolling alerts: 5xx rate +120% over baseline. Priority P1. @maya you're on-call  ///
maya: on it. joining now. can someone paste top-level alarm? ///
ops-bot: alarm details: env=prod, metric=frontend.5xx_rate, window=5m, value=12.3% (baseline 4.9%). affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. spike started ~2024-12-18T09:12:03Z. ///
sam: seeing correlated increase in envoy upstream 503s in logs. sample: 
```
# logs
[2024-12-18T09:13:14Z] x-request-id=abcd1234 host=api-redwood-1 upstream_status=503 x-envoy-upstream-service-time=34ms
[2024-12-18T09:13:15Z] x-request-id=abcd1256 host=api-redwood-2 upstream_status=502 x-envoy-upstream-service-time=120ms
```
///
raj: initial hypothesis: route-level `retries` on LB combined with a global circuit-breaker config mismatch — retries are re-issuing requests into overloaded upstream, amplifying failures. I'm seeing route config:
```
route: /v1/generate
  retries:
    retry_on: "5xx,connect-failure"
    num_retries: 4
```
and global cb:
```
circuit_breakers:
  default:
    max_connections: 800
    max_pending_requests: 80
    max_retries: 1
```
So route-level retries > cb.max_retries -> retry storm. ///
elaine: confirmed via metrics: upstream latency climbs after retries, queue depth increases. Heatmap attached to runbook. Impact: approx 10% of overall customer requests failing; top 3 tenants by error count: acme-co, bluebird, internal-playground. ///
hana: have a few support tickets from acme-co saying generation fails with 502/503; they're in EU. quoting: "sudden spike around 09:15, can't generate embeddings". ///
maya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable retries on problematic routes via runtime override 2) reduce LB weight to problematic upstream pool 3) open handoff to eng-runtime for config fix. Who can perform runtime modify? ///
sam: I can push runtime override to envoy admin. Suggest `runtime_modify` key flip: `routes.v1_generate.retries_enabled=false`. Command: 
```
curl -X POST 'http://envoy-admin:9901/runtime_modify?key=routes.v1_generate.retries_enabled&value=false'
```
I'll apply to eu-west first. ///
raj: also plan to add `max_retries: 1` at route-level to match global cb as a follow-up. For immediate, disabling retries is safest. ///
ops-bot: running change to eu-west fleet now (rolling): applied runtime key for 12/50 hosts, will continue. ///
(small pause) ///
sam: after initial 12 hosts change, 5xx rate in eu-west dropped from 14% -> 6% in 3m. continuing rollout. ///
elaine: monitor: latency stable, error budget reducing. please capture affected request IDs for postmortem. ///
incident-bot: note: on-call handoff inbound at 10:05Z; three blameless next steps added to incident doc. ///
maya: handover to raj at 10:07Z — summary for follow-up: caused by mismatch between route retries config and global cb limits; temporary mitigation: disabled route retries runtime key, reduced weight for upstream pool 'model-egress-2' by 20% for 15m, started canary rollback of recent lb policy change. Impact: ~10% requests failed, major customers: acme-co (EU), bluebird (US). Actions for eng-runtime: roll config to align retries and cb, add unit tests in config CI to prevent route>cb mismatch. ///
raj: taking lead. I'll patch envoy control plane with config diff to set `num_retries: 1` on route and adjust circuit_breaker thresholds; plan to deploy in a canary then full roll. Patch: 
```
- route.retries.num_retries: 4
+ route.retries.num_retries: 1
```
I'll also add a commit to config repo to add a lint that fails when route retries > cb.max_retries. ///
hana: customers notified via status page update (incident created). message drafted: "We're aware of elevated 5xxs affecting generation endpoints; mitigation in progress. ETA update in 30m." ; please confirm before posting. ///
maya: ack. publish status update now. ///
ops-bot: status page update posted. ///
sam: applying config patch to control plane canary now. will monitor. ///
(20m later) ///
ops-bot: canary applied to 10% of control plane; no regression observed after lowering retries to 1. Proceeding to full rollout. ///
elaine: metrics: global 5xx back to baseline (5%), user error impact dropped to ~1.2% in 30m. Good. ///
maya: switching incident state to "mitigated" but keep channel open for postmortem notes. handing to raj for follow-up. @raj you're on-call for the next 6h for remediation and postmortem. 

raj: ack. immediate follow-ups: 1) add lint/test to config CI, 2) run search for other routes where retries > cb.max_retries, 3) create runbook step to prefer runtime flag + circuit-breaker alignment. I'll file a PR and assign to eng-runtime and infra. ETA for PR: 48h. ///

maya: thanks team. nice quick work. please populate incident doc with timelines and customer list. closing handoff. :white_check_mark:
